notes: Desired: a printf/scanf call's variadic arguments carry the types its format string states. The default rendering used to be `printf("%d %s\n",(unsigned long)a0,*a1)` - the `%d` argument widened to the register and the `%s` argument left as the pointer's element type - because typing them cost a second decompile of every caller. The load-time resolver reads the constant out of the image instead.
